article.headline: Meyer scores 18 as Wyoming defeats Idaho State 93-62
article.description: — Nasir Meyer's 18 points helped Wyoming defeat Idaho State 93-62 on Friday.
article.linkText: Meyer scores 18 as Wyoming defeats Idaho State 93-62
article.story: LARAMIE, Wyo. -- — Nasir Meyer's 18 points helped Wyoming defeat Idaho State 93-62 on Friday. Meyer added nine rebounds for the Cowboys (2-0). Renars Sondors scored 14 points while going 4 of 8 (4 for 7 from 3-point range), and added five rebounds. Khaden Bennett shot 6 for 11 to finish with 13 points, adding six rebounds. MaCarhy Morris led the way for the Bengals (0-2) with 17 points. Joven Dulay added 16 points, and Malik Johnson also had seven points and three blocks. Wyoming took the lead with 19:22 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Meyer led the Cowboys in scoring with 11 points in the first half to help put them up 44-20 at the break. Wyoming pulled away with a 9-0 run in the second half to extend a 24-point lead to 33 points. They outscored Idaho State by seven points in the final half, as Madden Smiley led the way with a team-high eight second-half points. Up next Idaho State: visits Air Force on Sunday. Wyoming: at North Carolina on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
